description: A single radar shape with a solid dot marking the value on every axis.
overview: A single radar shape with a solid dot at the value on every axis. The dots make individual scores easier to locate than on the plain filled shape.
usage: Replace `chartData`, set the axis and value keys, and rename the series in `chartConfig`. Change the marker size through the `dot` prop on `Radar`, or set it to false to go back to the plain shape.
